_comment: Exp 51 (ONE-SHOT ARC) — BIOLOGY SPECIALIST EXAM. Target is a ground-truthed review document (exp51_biology.md, claims BI-01...), drafted to the locked spec, tool-verified claim-by-claim, panel draft-reviewed key-blind, with a SEPARATE answer key the reviewing panel never sees. Purpose: measure the biology specialist checkpoint against an answer key — the only recall measurement in the programme. Instrument identical to Exp 44-47 (two-sided gamma gate, CONFIRM-only falsifier gate, routing, location key on claim IDs, sweep, ImmuneMemory recording) with domain=biology as the declared variable. CDSFL is an LLM-reliability framework; domain content is verifiable subject matter only.
_stall_gamma_note: Stall-path gamma thresholds set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall detector can never fire via gamma — convergence rests on the two-sided gamma-alt gate. Config-level guard, identical to Exp 42/43.
_max_contested_rounds_note: FIX 4 (declared delta, 2026-07-22): lowered from the code default 5. Five rounds of paid compute to age out a churning residual was both wasteful and, against within-grace churn, ineffective (Exp 43). With FIX 1 in place sub-criticals no longer block, so this threshold now governs only genuinely contested items.

_convergence_criteria.description: TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10; hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is ACTIVE and LOAD-BEARING. Converged iff ALL of: (1) gamma_critical >= 0.30 on the location-keyed critical series; AND (2) 3 consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical (settled/verifier-filtered, location-keyed); AND (3) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe); AND (4) not contested — where, per FIX 1, un-demonstrated sub-critical findings are a logged NON-GATING residual queue; AND (5) not churning; AND (6) irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds AND no unverified critical pending AND not contested (FIX-1 semantics) AND not churning AND irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds; OR non-convergence (then assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy — do not demote gamma).

_directives_live._section_10_note: A4 (12 July 2026): section 10 was established INERT — the flag never reaches RunnerConfig and no compelled-convergence text reaches dispatch. Recorded false here for documentation accuracy; behaviourally identical to Exp 42/43, whose configs carried a stale 'true'.

_pre_registration: Frozen before the run. Exp 51 = biology exam. RATIFIED PASS MARK (founder 28 Jul, conjunctive, per domain): (1) attributed planted-false recall 100% — every planted false caught, credited to the routed specialist not the surrounding panel; (2) non-distortion — zero false refutations of planted-TRUE claims, and no finding raised against the clean control cluster; (3) decision-change tally, conditioned on baseline noise existing (an accurate panel with nothing to filter is NOT a specialist failure); (4) convergence non-distortion — the two-sided gate closes normally. Scoring joins the per-round specialist_verdicts_r*.json telemetry to the answer key post-run. PREDICTION: convergence within budget; recall measurable; sweep drains the tail. FAILURE MODES: non-convergence -> MECHANICAL, pause and diagnose, do NOT demote gamma; recall < 100% -> report per-claim with the routing trace, do not tune the exam. BUDGET NOTE: the specialist-off paired run (the decision-change counterfactual) is sequenced AFTER all four primary exams, subject to remaining budget — declared deviation for founder review, not silent omission.
_plan_ref: One-shot arc: 47 divergence -> 48 chem -> 49 eng -> 50 physics -> 51 biology -> 52 factorial -> STOP before BR2.
_locationkey_note: location keys from dm/_memory.py AST symbols; instrument proven on Exp 42/43/44.
_target_isolation_note: Target staged outside the repository, read-only (mode 444), one document per directory, named by the document's own internal ID. The panel's working directory is that directory and contains the document under review and nothing else: no scoring key, no sibling module, no git history, no experiment metadata in any path. Scoring joins the run's findings to the key after the run, outside the run, from a location this repository does not record. History: on 2026-07-29 a routed model wrote a falsifier that opened the scoring key and printed its full planted set. The key had been moved out of the tree that morning and a config note in this repository recorded where it went; the panel's working directory was the repository, so the note was one grep away. The fix had advertised what it hid. Superseded keys also remain in git history and are left there deliberately as a tripwire: the sets they name are no longer the sets in use, so a run that flags them without independent demonstration has done archaeology rather than verification.

_redesign_2026_09_10.ruling: Founder 2026-08-22: "5: Redesign with all uncovered fixes in place after the upcoming build experiment and any fixed it uncovers in place also." Task R2.
_redesign_2026_09_10.the_original_is_untouched: The file this derives from declares "Frozen before the run" and has NOT been edited. Neither experiment has ever run -- the only exp50 directory in the archive is a draft review -- so this is a redesign before the run rather than a rewrite after it.
_redesign_2026_09_10.measured_gap: scripts/exp50_51_redesign_gap_2026-09-10.py diffs these against the 3 newest pre-registration files. 14 of 68 settings were out of step, 20.5882%, Wilson [12.6796%, 31.6423%], Clopper-Pearson [11.7380%, 32.1238%].

target_kind.why: DECLARED rather than inferred. The test_article is a .md review document, so detect_target_kind returns prose at run time anyway -- but leaving it absent means the config does not say what the experiment is reviewing, and a reader cannot tell a deliberate prose exam from an oversight.

sk_enabled.why: FALSE, matching what the runner would enforce regardless. With target_kind prose the runner FORCES S_k off and logs it, because on prose the gates invert: ruff cannot parse the file, so a shell injection inside a fence scored 1.0000 ADMISSIBLE against 0.6667 for a correct prose fix (2026-08-01 control). Declaring true here reproduces the exact defect that note records -- 'sk_enabled is TRUE in all eight queued prose configs, against a code default of FALSE'. Task A19 carries the better long-term answer: score the computationally reducible elements inside the prose rather than abstaining on the whole file.

merge_arbitration_enabled.why: FALSE. The merge path is dead code: when arbitration votes MERGE the runner records merge_blocked_reason, logs MERGE WITHHELD and returns KEEP_DISTINCT. All 3 exp56 arms disable it for that reason and declare the delta. Leaving it true here enables a path that cannot act, which is the unwired half of the additive standard.

routing_enabled.why: DECLARED. Absent from the original, so it took the runner default silently. Task 3.1a repaired _apply_routing to intersect the orchestrator roster with the arm's declaration, so routing is now safe to declare explicitly and the 1-seat leak it used to cause is closed.

deliberately_unchanged.max_rounds: 16 is kept, NOT lowered to the exp56 convention of 8. This is a ONE-SHOT ARC against an answer key, not a 3-arm comparison; the exp56 value is sized for 3 arms run in sequence. Changing it would alter the experiment rather than repair it.
deliberately_unchanged.extension_cap: 16 kept, for the same reason as max_rounds.
deliberately_unchanged.immune_memory_enabled: TRUE is kept. exp56 disables it to stop arm 2 inheriting arm 1's findings, which is a CROSS-ARM contamination path. exp50 and exp51 are single-arm, so that path does not exist and the memory is a capability rather than a confound.

_redesign_2026_09_10.not_run: Both configs declare 5 models including 3 paid seats. Running them costs money, which is one of the founder's 3 standing categories requiring him in person. Nothing here dispatches anything.
